notes.title: Release date announced!
notes.content:
We are coming to steam on September 20! Mark your calendars!


We are working on the game for its final release. Full game and no early access. Pricing currently seems like 9.99$. We're sadly pulling support from Linux and Android because of time constraints. If you want it otherwise please contact us and we'll consider it after the game's release. In other news, we are planning to post about general gameplay of the game so stay tuned! In the meantime, here's a gif from the main menu:

https://media.giphy.com/media/JSqABjslN7xG7vAgzm/giphy.gif
(That Market button is an in-game market. Corpoct doesn't include microtransactions!)

Wishlist the game if you haven't already!

notes.title: Dev-log Archive : Ship Modules (Weapons, Shields and More!)
notes.content:
This dev-log posted before the steam store launch thus a bit old BUT most of the stuff you'll see, is still in the game. GIF resolutions vary to make the file sizes smaller and even


Hello everyone! We introduce modules!

What are modules anyway?
Modules are the core of our battle system. All ships have module slots of different amounts and filling them with corresponding randomized modules. The modules you'll see here is default modules. There will be different variations. There are 3 module categories. (Ship Behaviors are deliberately disabled for the showcase)
https://media.giphy.com/media/iEw2wEzrsml7upJ0N7/giphy.gif

Attack Modules
It's pretty straightforward. These are the modules that damage the enemy ship. They select their own target within their range and attack it. They use your resources to shoot (Energy and/or Material). If they're out of resource they use, they stop attacking.

Projectile Module
https://media.giphy.com/media/J4P0dimIj0LvyG67bs/giphy.gif
This module will shoot faster but each bullet inflicts less damage than other modules and usually has low range. It uses Material to shoot and it has reduced damage against Armors. Deals Projectile Damage


Laser Module
https://media.giphy.com/media/W63BDdDZtHlOc5jV0I/giphy.gif
This module's bullet doesn't have travel time so there is no delay between damage and shoot. It uses Energy to shoot and it has reduced damage against Shields. Deals Energy Damage


Missile Module
https://media.giphy.com/media/J54S7Dlq4KtWianrvy/giphy.gif
This module usually has the longest range and damage. Missiles can be destroyed by The Point Defense Module thus makes it unreliable in some conditions. It also uses Material to shoot. Deals Missile Damage


Defense Modules
Ships have internal health to sustain some damage. But sometimes it's not enough. These modules provide extra durability. These are passive modules and doesn't require any resource to work. (for now)

Armor Module
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35663305/f124f199400fdbf7baa9793ca4efe36cd6bd8389.png
This module gives armor to connected ship. Armor adds to ship's health so it increases the durability of the ship. But it is especially effective against projectile damage. 


Shield Module
https://media.giphy.com/media/ZZYNFgwd5T0iTTgFKi/giphy.gif
This module gives shield to connected ship. But it also protects the surrounding area from incoming enemy attacks. It's more effective against laser module.


Point Defense Module
https://media.giphy.com/media/WTRG8e4KUm97WyzDvb/giphy.gif
Point defense works differently than the other two. It completely blocks missiles but ignores other damages. It also attacks nearby mini-fighter ships (Spawns from hangar modules). It has to wait for cooldown after each shot.


Utility Modules
These modules have great diversity that usually helps you in battle or your long term goals

Reactor, Factory, Trade Module
https://media.giphy.com/media/ibX7fIY9nKLqsysa2L/giphy.gif
These modules give their corresponding resources with each jump.


Hangar Module
This feature is not implemented yet. (It's implemented! As I said, it's an old dev-log) Sorry for no visuals. It will spawn mini-fighters that attack ships at long range.


Conclusion
These modules you saw, are only default ones. We'll create different versions of the same module (fast missile etc). The game will randomly select modules for each module slot in each ship. You'll have a choice to select which one of these randomly generated ships Wishlist the game to stay tuned with the game's progress!
